review_description: You feel more confident when the experts visit your home so they can sees issues which you don't see. This I believe helps you make more informed decosions.

Sunny Afternoons sent a local sales rep who was resident in and knew the area and who was able to point us to other domestic and business installations by them. He sensibly assessed our domestic needs and "talked down" our requirements from a 3kW system (my choice) to a 2kW system, which he said would be adequate for us and would be more affordable. He really seemed interested in our needs and application of solar energy to our day-to-day circmstances and didn't try to spruik up something more than we actually needed. Being retirees and pensioners he was sensitive to our situation and recommended the best options for us and our budget, such as using Chinese-built solar panels rather than German-built ones.
